text:
Eli: Heads up: there's a Tupperware in the fridge labeled 'For Office' but no clue what's inside. Smells suspiciously like cumin. Chili? Salsa? Mystery stew? :detective:
Noor: If it's spicy, it's probably Gabe's experimental 'five-chile surprise'. Proceed with caution. :fire:
Gabe: I plead the fifth. But I will say it pairs well with bravery and sour cream. :wink:
Becca: Quick poll: react :one: if you want chili, :two: if you want salsa, :three: if you want to surrender your plate to science and try both.
Priya: One-liner incentive: best food pun gets dibs on the first scoop. Drop your puns. :trophy:
Noor: "That's nacho average potluck." Boom.
Eli: Nice. "Lettuce rejoice, it's dinner time." I'm stealing that for my caption.
Gabe: "It cumin to this." (Yes that's intentional.) :grimacing:
Becca: ops-bot: FYI, fridge is a shared resource. Label items with name and date or they'll be sacrificed to the communal lunch ritual.
ops-bot: Reminder: Lost & Found food will be cleared every Friday at 5pm. Please claim per policy.
Noor: Tally so far: 1s vs 2s vs 3s - leaning towards 3. Science wins.
Priya: If 3 wins, we enact the Taste Test Protocol: small spoons, score 1-5 for 'delicious', 'suspicious', 'hall of fame'. Document results in #random for posterity.
Eli: Vote result: 3 wins. Science committee convenes at 12:10. Whoever takes a bite must leave a one-line verdict in this thread.
Gabe: I volunteer as tribute. Verdict incoming.
Becca: Lunch-bot: small reminder to log allergen info when you bring shared food.
lunch-bot: Thanks for the reminder! Please add ingredients in #kitchen-notes or on the fridge label.
Gabe: Verdict: It's chili-ish, confidently caffeinated with cumin, 4/5 "would beta-test again". Also, whoever made this: top-tier mystery cooking. :raised_hands:
